items.title: 4.8 Theoretical yield, actual yield aur percentage yield (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.8, printed pages 89-91, with Sample Problem 4.20 worked (corrected) and Quick Check 4.10 answered.

blocks.title: Actual yield aur theoretical yield
blocks.text: Reaction mein asal mein jitna product hasil hota hai woh actual yield hai. Balanced chemical equation se hisab laga kar jitna product nikalta hai woh theoretical yield hai.
Theoretical yield product ki woh maximum (zyada se zyada) amount hai jo reactant ki di hui amount se balanced equation ke mutabiq ban sakti hai.
Zyada tar reactions mein hasil hone wala product theoretical yield se kam hota hai. Is ki reasons (wajah) yeh hain:

items: Filtration, distillation, separating funnel se alag karna, dhona, sukhana aur crystallization agar theek se na kiye jayein to actual yield kam ho jati hai.
Kuch reactants kisi doosri side reaction mein lag jate hain aur desired (chahiye wala) product kam banta hai.
Reaction reversible ho sakta hai; ulta (backward) reaction product ko kam kar deta hai.

blocks.text: Chemist ko reaction ki efficiency (karkardagi) mein dilchaspi hoti hai. Efficiency ko actual aur theoretical yield ka comparison (muqabla) kar ke percentage (%) yield ki shakal mein likhte hain:

blocks.text_alt: % Yield = Actual yield / Theoretical yield x 100

blocks.text: Percentage yield jitni zyada, reaction ki efficiency utni zyada; aur kam ho to kam.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.20 (% yield)
blocks.problem: Aspirin (C₉H₈O₄, molar mass 180.16 g mol⁻¹) salicylic acid, C₇H₆O₃ (138.12 g mol⁻¹), aur acetic anhydride, C₄H₆O₃ (102.09 g mol⁻¹), ko garam kar ke banti hai: C₇H₆O₃ + C₄H₆O₃ → C₉H₈O₄ + CH₃COOH. 3.00 g salicylic acid ko 6.00 g acetic anhydride ke saath garam kiya gaya. Theoretical yield kya hai, aur actual yield 3.15 g ho to % yield kya hai?
steps: Equation mein 1 mol salicylic acid se 1 mol aspirin banti hai
Salicylic acid ke moles = 3.00 g ÷ 138.12 g mol⁻¹ = 0.022 mol
Acetic anhydride ke moles = 6.00 g ÷ 102.09 g mol⁻¹ = 0.059 mol
Salicylic acid kam hai, is liye woh limiting reactant hai; acetic anhydride excess hai
0.022 mol salicylic acid se aspirin = 0.022 mol
Theoretical yield = 0.022 mol x 180.16 g mol⁻¹ = 3.96 g

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sample 4.20 mein kai ghaltiyan hain. (1) Acetic anhydride, C₄H₆O₃, ka molar mass 163.93 likha hai; sahi 102.09 g mol⁻¹ hai, is liye 6.00 g = 0.059 mol (0.037 nahi); salicylic acid phir bhi limiting hai. Kitab ne is 6.00 g ko “Mass of Salicylic acid” bhi likh diya hai. (2) “0.22 mol” aur “0.021 mol” likha hai jahan 0.022 mol hona chahiye. (3) Sawal actual yield 3.15 g deta hai magar solution 2.85 g leta hai; sahi % yield = 3.15 ÷ 3.96 x 100 = taqreeban 79.5 % (71.97 % nahi).

blocks.prompt: Limestone (CaCO₃) ko bhoonne (roast karne) se quicklime (CaO) banta hai (equation oopar hai). 4.5 kg limestone se CaO ki actual yield 2.5 kg hai. Percentage yield kya hai? (CaCO₃ = 100 g/mol, CaO = 56 g/mol)
blocks.explanation: 4500 g ÷ 100 g/mol = 45 mol CaCO₃, jo 45 mol CaO dega = 45 x 56 = 2520 g = 2.52 kg (theoretical yield). % yield = 2.5 ÷ 2.52 x 100 = taqreeban 99 %.

items: Theoretical yield: equation se nikla zyada se zyada product; actual yield: jo asal mein mila.
% yield = actual ÷ theoretical x 100; yeh efficiency batati hai.
Actual yield kam hoti hai: alag karne aur saaf karne mein nuqsan, side reactions, reversible reactions.
